# T-001 (M1): HTTP server skeleton

Allowed: wsd/__init__.py wsd/__main__.py wsd/server.py web/index.html tests/test_server.py

Build the base the later tasks plug into.

wsd/__init__.py: `__version__ = "0.1.0"`.

wsd/server.py:
- `ROUTES: dict[str, Callable[[], object]]` and a decorator `route(path)` that registers a GET handler returning JSON-serialisable data.
- Built-in route `/api/health` -> `{"status": "ok", "version": __version__}`.
- `make_server(host="127.0.0.1", port=8765)` returns a `ThreadingHTTPServer`. Raise `ValueError` if host is not a loopback address (127.0.0.0/8 or ::1).
- GET `/` serves web/index.html. GET `/static/<name>` serves files from web/ only; any path that resolves outside web/ returns 404.
- Unknown path -> 404 with JSON `{"error": "not found"}`. Any method other than GET or HEAD -> 405 with a JSON error.
- A handler that raises -> 500 with JSON `{"error": "<exception class name>"}`; the server keeps running.
- JSON responses: `Content-Type: application/json`, `Cache-Control: no-store`. Silence the default per-request stderr logging.

wsd/__main__.py: `python3 -m wsd [--port N]` starts the server and prints the URL.

web/index.html: a minimal page titled "Workstation Dashboard" that fetches /api/health and shows the status and version.

tests/test_server.py: start the server on port 0 in a background thread. Test health, index page, /static traversal (`/static/../wsd/server.py` and an encoded `%2e%2e` form) -> 404, unknown -> 404, POST -> 405, a handler that raises -> 500, non-loopback host -> ValueError.

Acceptance: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -q` passes with at least 8 tests.
